verdict.rationale: Gusto's own HR resources let owners build an employee handbook (a policy document) and generate HR documents such as performance improvement plans and termination letters, which partly covers routine policy paperwork. Nothing shows NDAs, commercial agreements, a broader template library, or that the templates are attorney-vetted. missing for 10: NDA and contract/agreement templates, evidence of a browsable template library, evidence the templates are legally vetted, independent or hands-on corroboration.
